title: AGR 102 - Agricultural Ecology and Sustainable Farming

items.q: Which term is described by “the growing of food crops in the spaces between rows of pruned trees”?
o: Cover crop
Alley cropping
Fallow
Crop rotation
items.s: Alley cropping is the growing of food crops in the spaces between rows of pruned trees.

items.q: The statement “the amount of rain that reaches an area over a stated period” describes which of the following?
o: Rainfall
Climate
Weather
Photoperiodism
items.s: Rainfall is the amount of rain that reaches an area over a stated period.

items.q: Compost may be defined as
o: a chemical preparation applied to kill insect pests on crops
the total water lost by soil evaporation and by plant transpiration
animal dung mixed with bedding, used to enrich the soil
decayed farm and household waste used to improve the soil
items.s: Compost: decayed farm and household waste used to improve the soil. The other options describe Evapotranspiration, Insecticide, Manure.

items.q: Which term is described by “the way soil particles are bound together into crumbs and aggregates”?
o: Soil structure
Mycorrhiza
Edaphic factor
Decomposition
items.s: Soil structure is the way soil particles are bound together into crumbs and aggregates.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Decomposition?

cutting level steps into a hillside so that soil and water stay
the breaking down of dead plant and animal matter by soil organisms
the total water lost by soil evaporation and by plant transpiration
items.s: Decomposition: the breaking down of dead plant and animal matter by soil organisms. The other options describe Agro-ecosystem, Terracing, Evapotranspiration.

items.q: All of the following belong to Sustainable farming practices EXCEPT
o: Organic farming
Sustainable agriculture
Green manure
Conservation agriculture
items.s: Every other option belongs to Sustainable farming practices. “Green manure” belongs to Intercropping and rotations, not Sustainable farming practices.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Habitat.

the practice of preventing soil loss and keeping the land productive
the condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time
items.s: Habitat: the natural home or place where a particular organism lives and grows. The other options describe Nitrogen fixation, Weather, Soil conservation.

ploughing along lines of equal height to slow the run-off of water
items.s: Compost: decayed farm and household waste used to improve the soil. The other options describe Field capacity, Contour ploughing, Relay cropping.
